outcome: In-hospital clinical burden (length of stay, mortality)
cohort: Adults who underwent digestive, gynaecologic/obstetric, cardiac, or orthopaedic surgery between January 1, 2019, and November 30, 2020, in France.
finding: Surgical site infections significantly increase in-hospital mortality, length of hospital stay, and hospital costs across various types of surgeries.
mod_finding: For gynaecologic/obstetric surgeries (which include caesarean sections), 0.1% of patients experienced an SSI, leading to 7 extra hospital days, an additional cost of EUR5363, and an in-hospital mortality hazard ratio of 7.24.
followup_time: 30 days for gynaecologic/obstetric surgeries (and other non-orthopaedic surgeries), 90 days for orthopaedic patients (post-surgery).
